prompt:
GAME ITEM ICON. Camera above the object looking down at about sixty degrees, the way the game RimWorld draws loose items on the floor. One single object, centred, with its long axis level.

Create an ORIGINAL game item sprite for the D'thorga reduction gearbox: the heavy gearbox that slows a turbine's fast shaft down to turn a helicopter's rotor. Image 1 is our approved vehicle part from the same family: match its outline weight, shading, palette and finish only. Do NOT copy its shape.

Draw ONLY the gearbox, alone on a plain pure white background, filling about 75 percent of the canvas. Square canvas.

A squat, rounded grey cast-alloy gearbox housing with a short thick vertical output shaft and a splined flange standing up from its top, a smaller input shaft stub sticking out of one side, cooling ribs around the housing and a ring of bolt heads where its two halves join.

Style: a sprite for the game RimWorld: a thick near-black outline around every shape, soft flat cel shading with two or three tones per material, pale panels, rounded corners, a few small clean details, no texture noise. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not pixel art. It must read clearly when shrunk to 64 pixels: three big shapes, few small ones.

No people, hands, animals, vehicles, rotor blades, text, letters, numbers, logos, dials, dust, floor, ground or cast shadow.
